system.description:
SOUL UTILITY WARDING
Tradition divinity
Cast 10 minutes (material, somatic, verbal)
Range touch
Area one doorway, gate, arch or other opening no more than 20 feet across
Duration 8 hours

You establish a spiritual boundary across the chosen threshold.
A disembodied spirit or incorporeal Undead attempting to cross the boundary must attempt a Will saving throw.
Critical: The creature crosses normally.
Success: The creature crosses but becomes Weakened 1 until the end of its next turn.
Failure: The creature cannot cross the ward for 1 minute.
Fumble: The creature cannot voluntarily cross the ward for duration.
An effect attempting to establish possession through the ward, or to move a disembodied spirit across it using Teleportation or similar magic, must first successfully Counteract Threshold Ward. The ward does not prevent ordinary corporeal creatures, including corporeal Undead or Unliving characters, from physically crossing the threshold.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: Protect an opening up to 40 feet across.
+4 PP: Increase the duration to 1 day.
+6 PP: Increase the duration to 1 week.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10. The ward is a line Region across the opening: a disembodied spirit or incorporeal Undead crossing it rolls the Will save, and Failure or Fumble puts it back outside.
